Preserve its proportions and painting. No clothes or accessories; no other characters.

Soft matte gouache illustration, layered brushwork, broad readable shapes, gently softened painted edges and subtle paper texture. Preserve the reference monkey and woodland paint, warm afternoon sun and cool sage shadows. No outlines, glossy3D rendering, text, captions or watermark.

The supplied first frame is the exact design/continuity input: keep both existing sticks, their full shafts, the single visible X-shaped contact, both grips and the clear ground. Do not introduce a third stick or a support log. Keep the little fire confined to the existing X contact, well away from his face.
